statusScreen.source: Feature report 8 of the Stream Deck module (read 2026-10-18) ends with d0 02 80 01 = 720 x 384 little-endian; galleon-deck docs/PROTOCOL.md and OpenActionAPI/rust-elgato-streamdeck PR #63 give the same size. Confirmed on the hardware: a 720 x 384 JPEG sent by galleond fills the whole screen (2026-10-18).
statusScreen.mmSource: Measured 2026-10-19 from a phone photo of the module lit in plain white (galleond --show-calibration): the 11 lit key areas and the screen were found by thresholding, the photo was straightened with a homography fitted on the key centres (residual 0.08 mm: the grid is regular; the straightened screen has an aspect of 1.91 against 1.875 for its 720 x 384 pixels), and the scale comes from the 32.3 mm between the two dial rings given by the module's own LampArray data (it gives a pitch of 19.15 mm, the 19.05 mm of a standard key). Accuracy about 0.5 mm (screen height about 0.7 mm). Replace with ruler measurements when available.

keys.source: Pixel sizes: feature report 8 holds a0 00 a0 00 = 160 x 160 (read 2026-10-18); galleon-deck gives 160 x 160 JPEG. Grid: report 8 starts with 04 03 and galleon-deck says 3 keys wide and 4 high (rust-elgato-streamdeck PR #63 writes it as 4 x 3: only the orientation of the wording differs, 12 keys). Key and gap sizes in mm: to measure with a ruler.

throughput.source: Measured 2026-10-19 with `galleond --measure-throughput` on the module (firmware 3.06.005), hidapi on Linux: 40 screen frames of 720 x 384 in 895 ms, 10 rounds of 12 keys of 160 x 160 in 285 ms, 10 rounds of screen + 12 keys in 497 ms. JPEG encoding included (8.9 ms for the screen picture alone). Noisy gradient pictures, about the size of video frames.
